name: Shizukura Kamiya
source:
Class: Year 1?

A mysterious girl who always carries around a parasol and has a tendency to appear out of nowhere. She speaks in a distinctive and old-fashioned way. Kamiya is often seen strolling around the academy, but because nobody knows her true identity, she is treated as if she were some kind of a fairy or mythical being. Each time she appears in front of [url=/c130994]Yamato[/url], he has to go along with her whims, before she eventually leaves. 

She loves meat and especially loves eating yakiniku, yakitori, and roast pork. At the same time, she can't stand raw foods like sashimi.

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1292095]Getchu[/url]]
